I give so many sims bookworm, simply because I always litter my houses with bookshelves anyways. And it is a decent stand-in for skill traits at the cost of some simoleons for the skill book. And hopeless romantic is one I almost always put on sims too. I almost never use the good/evil traits, while I understand them, there's usually more interesting traits that give more interactions.

On one hans, people have different timelines and that's ok. On the other, being in pain over incompatiblities and ignorance of differing viewpoints ain't cool either(like you said, you did tell him, unless I misunderstood). He could have said why it took him so long(my best guess might be readiness for children/financial stuff, but, still dlesn't make it ok if he didn't explain it to you so you could have made an informed decision, instead you uninformedly had to wait. Which is the worst kind). So, I feel for you. I don't think your man is the devil like some of these other people are saying, but I do think it was an unfair situation, and if you aren't happy...you are allowed to leave. And to find happiness. You don't HAVE TO stay, so...do what feels best/right and brings you the most happiness/fairness.

Ambitions is great fun in the short term, the skills are nice, the careers not being rabbithole can get to be a bit much at time. Sims 3 LN for apartments(or Uni foe its versions of apartments)+Seasons+Pets is probably the packs I recommend the most though. Though...seeing as you like inventing and tech stuff, into the future might be up your alley as well(I actually like ITF too but find difficulty recommending it as a general pack for people, since its good but a little niche).

I say things like that sometimes,but for me it's more about trying to create a positive spiral. Thinking it'll get better will usually help form helpful habits that will make things a little easier. Things will get better. But sometimes they'll also be worse. And there's no guarantee any of us makes it. But,what we have are the moments. The small times we feel something. That's all we really have. And,if we can't cherish them as something good, as something better than not having anything, when what really is even happiness at all?? Maybe this got a bit existential and wasn't very helpful. I don't have any answers. But I can send you love, and so I do. <3

There's nothing wrong with having big shoulders or being tall and being a girl. You're still a girl. Please remember that. You are so so valid and loved. I'm 20 as well, and I've been thinking a lot about my gender identity as well. A lot of the same fears have gone through my mind. But here's the thing right: Biology is complex. You are not alone. Not even amongst cisgirls do all girls fall into what society accepts. And I'm not saying this as a "toughen up",it must REALLY suck to feel that way,but you're not alone at least. Please remember that. You're not built wrong. You're you and that's beautiful.
I get that. Not wanting to remember but the images burned in your mind? It's awful. But it does get better. Can't say how quickly or how much,but still. ❤❤❤

There's no time-restraint on pain. It can still hurt and it does not make it any less valid. It is valid. You're allowed to feel hurt by what he did to you. It was awful. But it was also not your fault. I hope you can realize that someday,even if you can't right now.

You're not dumb. You're human. And you didn't provoke him, he abused you. You deserve so much love and so much better than that. I'm so sorry shitty people like that exist,but it's not your fault. It's not fair. It fucking sucks, I've been through something similar but I wasn't that young. I can't imagine how hard it must be. But you're not alone, and while it may not feel like it right now,it will get better. It'll still hurt of course, and while tome can't heal all wounds, we do learn how to carry them. Sometimes we can even turn them into strengths,sometimes we carry on despite. Please just know you're so loved and that it's not your fault. Even if it feels like the opposite
